slope.note: 38.9 is area-weighted over a Delaunay mesh of the 29 points inside the boundary. The plane is gentler because the surface undulates.

aspect.note: the road bears 29.75, which is 52 degrees off the contour. Building parallel to the road means crossing the slope.

slope_bands_pct_of_plot.note: 19.4% of the plot is over 50% and cannot legally be built on at all

survey_coverage.warning: anything outside this window is extrapolation and must be labelled as such. Candidate re-negotiated parcels to the north-east are only 28-37% covered.

sun.view_protection: eye level about 94.85 m. Anyone below the 80 m contour building the full 12 m tops out at 92 m, 3.8 m below eye level. The horizon and the whole sunset arc are safe.
